---
title: "CGT: Capital Gains Tax"
description: "Information about capital gains tax paid by persons or sole traders on profits from disposing of assets such as property, shares and crypto assets."
---

Information about capital gains tax paid by persons or sole traders on profits from disposing of assets such as property, shares and crypto assets.

*Explains CGT events, capital gains and losses, affected assets and tax-return reporting.*

Losses are applied before the discount, so where a taxpayer puts them is a choice with a tax consequence: the ATO notes that for most people the order giving the smallest net capital gain is to apply losses against other-method gains first, then indexation, then discount. A large figure here therefore often signals either an adviser's deliberate choice or a year with no other-method gains to absorb the losses.","dsrc":"ATO, Guide to capital gains tax","durl":"https://caat-p-001.sitecorecontenthub.cloud/api/public/content/62327127-22dc-4be1-8fbe-031cb313496a_7bbe17ea_9cd6_4c09_8d67_211d38ed98e8_pdf","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Total capital losses applied - discount method","k":"Capital losses applied, discount method (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of losses applied, not the losses available. The ATO describes it as follows: \"The small business 50% active asset reduction: this concession provides a 50% reduction of a capital gain for an active asset.\" Applied after the CGT discount, it takes an already-halved gain and halves it again, so a long-held active asset can reach the return at a quarter of its nominal gain.","dsrc":"ATO, Guide to capital gains tax","durl":"https://caat-p-001.sitecorecontenthub.cloud/api/public/content/62327127-22dc-4be1-8fbe-031cb313496a_7bbe17ea_9cd6_4c09_8d67_211d38ed98e8_pdf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Small business active asset reduction - Capital gains - discount method","k":"Small business active asset reduction, discount method (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of gain removed by the concession, not the gain itself. It is one of several concessions and a zero here does not mean no concession was used.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12","and 1 more"]},{"n":"G_SB_CONC_BUS_RLVR_OTH_T","d":"The small business roll-over claimed against gains that were not worked out under the discount method.","full":"The small business roll-over claimed against gains that were not worked out under the discount method. Read with the discount-method column, the pair gives the year's whole deferral.","dsrc":"ATO, Guide to capital gains tax","durl":"https://caat-p-001.sitecorecontenthub.cloud/api/public/content/62327127-22dc-4be1-8fbe-031cb313496a_7bbe17ea_9cd6_4c09_8d67_211d38ed98e8_pdf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Small business roll-over - Other capital gains","k":"Small business roll-over, other method (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of gain deferred, not forgiven.","p":"2000-2001 to 2012-2013","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Guide to capital gains tax","url":"https://caat-p-001.sitecorecontenthub.cloud/api/public/content/62327127-22dc-4be1-8fbe-031cb313496a_7bbe17ea_9cd6_4c09_8d67_211d38ed98e8_pdf","lim":"A roll-over is a timing difference, so treating this column as relief overstates the concession's cost and understates gains in later years.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12","and 1 more"]},{"n":"G_SB_CONC_BUSRLVR_DISC_S","d":"The small business roll-over claimed against gains worked out under the discount method.","full":"The small business roll-over claimed against gains worked out under the discount method. Collectables are a separate class in the ATO's records - \"those relating to collectables (for example, jewellery)\" - and they are separate because their losses are ring-fenced: \"You can only use capital losses from collectables to reduce capital gains from collectables.\" They sit under non-active assets because they cannot qualify for the small business concessions.","dsrc":"ATO, Guide to capital gains tax","durl":"https://caat-p-001.sitecorecontenthub.cloud/api/public/content/62327127-22dc-4be1-8fbe-031cb313496a_7bbe17ea_9cd6_4c09_8d67_211d38ed98e8_pdf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Non-active assets - Collectables: Capital gains - discount method","k":"Collectables capital gains, discount method (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of gain on collectables, before the discount percentage is applied.","p":"2000-2001 to 2012-2013","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Guide to capital gains tax","url":"https://caat-p-001.sitecorecontenthub.cloud/api/public/content/62327127-22dc-4be1-8fbe-031cb313496a_7bbe17ea_9cd6_4c09_8d67_211d38ed98e8_pdf","lim":"The ring-fencing means a loss on collectables cannot reduce any other gain, so a taxpayer with collectables losses and other gains still pays tax on the gains. The ATO says a taxpayer uses one of three methods for each asset - \"indexation method\", \"discount method, or\" the \"'other' method\" - and the discount method is available only where the asset was held at least twelve months: \"If you bought and sold your asset within 12 months, you must use the 'other' method\". The split matters because the discount is not applied yet: \"If you use the discount method, do not apply the discount percentage until you have applied current year capital losses and unapplied net capital losses from earlier years.\"","dsrc":"ATO, Guide to capital gains tax","durl":"https://caat-p-001.sitecorecontenthub.cloud/api/public/content/62327127-22dc-4be1-8fbe-031cb313496a_7bbe17ea_9cd6_4c09_8d67_211d38ed98e8_pdf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total current year capital gains (CYCG) - Capital gains - discount method","k":"Capital gains amount, discount method (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount, gross of losses, the CGT discount and the small business concessions.
